lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly five horizontal rows along the mid-flank, with spot diameter increasing towards the central longitudinal axis and decreasing towards the dorsal ridge.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a distinct rectangular coordinate system of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible; the primary medial ridge exhibits a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge, following a linear path towards the caudal region.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, irregularly spaced high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily along the posterior half of the dorsal fin's lateral surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A high-density cluster of commensal organisms (Echeneidae) is positioned along the ventral midline and the posterior margin of the pectoral fin, creating significant silhouette distortion in the lower-central quadrant.
